newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's reinsurer Tunis-Re to raise capital.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's reinsurer Tunis-Re to raise capital.

text.p: Societe Tunisienne de Reassurance Tunis-Re on Monday said it plans to raise its capital to 35 million dinars from 15 million.
Tunis-Re was launched in 1981 with the government owning 10 percent, Tunisian insurance companies 42 percent and Tunisian banks the remaining 48 percent.

Tunis-Re said that in parallel to the capital raising, it will issue negotiable investment certificates. It said it will announce later how and when the capital will be raised and the certificates issued.
The firm is one of the five off-shore reinsurance firms established in Tunisia.
